item.title: LATAM pushing ahead with transatlantic expansion
item.description: LATAM Airlines is continuing its transatlantic expansion at the end of this month with the launch of flights from Sao Paulo to Amsterdam. The passenger service, which fields B787-9 aircraft, kicks off on 30 March with four weekly flights and will rise to six flights a week by 18 April. In June a second new transatlantic passenger service, also using B787-9s, will connect Sao Paulo with Brussels. This route will be ... item.title: Air cargo rates surge as Gulf disruption deepens and capacity reshapes global flows
item.description: Air cargo rates are continuing to climb sharply as disruption in the Middle East intensifies, with capacity constraints, fuel shocks and network shifts combining to reshape global supply chains.
